name: Sicilian Defense
description: A fighting response to 1.e4 where Black challenges the center from the side and creates imbalanced play.

moves.explanation: Black attacks the d4 square and creates an asymmetrical position.

ideas: Fight for d4 instead of mirroring with e5.
Develop quickly because the position can open fast.
Look for queenside counterplay while respecting White's center.
commonMistakes: Playing too many pawn moves before developing.
Trading into positions you do not understand yet.
